description: AGSC-08-10: ci writes the gate verdict once per run to dist/gate.json as a JCS-canonical object {gate, level, checks:[{name, status, findings}], status} followed by one LF (AGSC-04-04), status pass or fail; gate is the slug of the Bundle's gate item, or ci with level L1 when the Bundle holds none; a Bundle that holds several gate items writes one such object per gate as a JCS-canonical array in slug order. Each sub-case runs `ci --json` over a scratch copy of the minimal fixture with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH set and no git history. The fixture holds no gate item: one object, gate ci, level L1. With two gate items added, review-gate (L2) and link-gate (L1), an array of two, link-gate first by code point. verdicts gives gate, level and status of each object in file order; verdict_is_array says whether the file holds an array; verdict_members and check_members are the exact member names of each object and of each check, compared as sets. The names of the checks are an implementation's and are not compared.
